paper.title_en: Analytical Criteria for Black Hole Instability in Non-Minimally Coupled Scalar-Tensor Theories
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that the robustness of black hole stability is not preserved when perturbations are subjected to critical values of the coupling constant in two non-minimally coupled scalar-tensor models, particularly for several regular black holes. Our main result is the derivation of a general near-horizon analytical criterion for the onset of instability, which yields analytical expressions for the critical coupling constants in both coupling models. Numerical time-domain analysis shows that these critical values are coincident with the threshold points of the field perturbation profiles. At the critical coupling, the effective potential of the Regge-Wheeler equation develops an extremum exactly at the location of event horizon. We further show that, in the near-horizon regime, the real parts of the quasi-normal frequencies vanish, giving rise to purely imaginary modes. Finally, we recover the universal area quantization of spherically symmetric black holes at the critical coupling without resorting to the highly damped-mode approximation, and show that the result is independent of the particular non-minimal coupling model.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提供了非最小耦合标量-张量理论中黑洞不稳定性的解析判据，具有理论深度和清晰的方法论，属于广义相对论基础领域。
decision.title_zh: 非最小耦合标量-张量理论中黑洞不稳定性的解析判据
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们表明，当扰动受到两个非最小耦合标量-张量模型中耦合常数的临界值影响时，黑洞稳定性的鲁棒性不会被保留，特别是对于几个规则黑洞。我们的主要结果是推导出近地平线不稳定性的普遍解析判据，该判据在两种耦合模型中给出了临界耦合常数的解析表达式。数值时域分析表明，这些临界值与场扰动剖面的阈值点重合。在临界耦合下，Regge-Wheeler方程的有效势在事件地平线的位置处恰好产生一个极值。我们进一步表明，在近地平线区域内，准正规频率的实部消失，产生纯虚模式。最后，我们在不依赖高阻尼模式近似的情况下，恢复了球对称黑洞在临界耦合下的普遍面积量子化，并表明结果与特定的非最小耦合模型无关。
